about: Monster overlays (touch / enter) over a captive with no skin tone (skin -1: special classes, most mod characters): the game's generic overlays hold 3 rows per cell (one per skin tone), so her frame must skip to her cell's row x 3. Without it WALL 3 and 4 drew another cell's pose. Fixture modded (an occupied WALL 3, h_type 7: row 6, 5 frames per row).
